name: @agentry/web
description: Agentry's public marketing site — a static Astro one-pager ("show the receipts" observatory) that embeds the real eval dashboard. Deployable, never published; nothing imports it.

scripts.prebuild: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({existsSync})=>{for(const f of ['scripts/load-metrics.mjs','scripts/embed-dashboard.mjs'])if(!existsSync(f)){console.log('[prebuild] '+f+' not present yet (T3) — skipping data step');process.exit(0)}import('node:child_process').then(({execSync})=>execSync('pnpm run metrics && pnpm run embed',{stdio:'inherit'}))})"
